goals.goal: Where processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, a documented data-protection impact assessment covering the four Art. 35(7) content items (systematic description of envisaged processing and purposes; necessity and proportionality assessment; risks to data-subject rights and freedoms; measures to address those risks) is in place before processing begins; where residual risk remains high, prior consultation with the supervisory authority is sought.
goals.adjustment: Restated for an 8-employee B2B SaaS controller processing customer account metadata and task data; the four Art. 35(7) content items are mandatory regardless of entity size; no mechanism or tool prescribed.

goals.goal: The data-protection impact assessment is reviewed where there has been a change of the risk represented by the processing operations, with the review records identifying the trigger event, date, assessment of the change, residual-risk recalculation, and any updated measures.
goals.adjustment: Restated for a small B2B SaaS controller; the on-change review trigger is mandatory; a documented periodic-review cadence supplements the material-change trigger per the corpus interpretation; no mechanism prescribed.

goals.goal: Before placing the product with digital elements on the EU market, a documented cybersecurity risk assessment covering the intended purpose and reasonably foreseeable use (including operational environment and assets to be protected) is in place, indicating whether and in what manner Annex I Part I (2) requirements apply and how those requirements are implemented as informed by the risk assessment, recorded in the Annex VII §3 risk-assessment record.
goals.source: Art. 13(2); Art. 13(3) sentence 1; Art. 13(3) sentence 2; Art. 13(3) sentence 3; Annex VII §3
goals.adjustment: Restated for a default-class manufacturer (self-assessment conformity) of a rule-based SaaS product; the Annex I Part I (2) applicability mapping is mandatory; the CRA Art. 13(4) sentence 2 consolidation rule does not apply (no AI Act applicability for this entity); no mechanism prescribed.

goals.goal: The cybersecurity risk assessment is updated during the support period as appropriate, including upon becoming aware of a previously unidentified vulnerability, with the Annex VII §3 risk-assessment record kept current and available to market surveillance authorities for the retention period.
goals.adjustment: Restated for a small manufacturer with a defined support period; the update obligation is mandatory regardless of entity size; the 10-year retention per Art. 13(13) applies; no mechanism prescribed.
